about: Dust storm schedule (docs/design/balance-sheet.md section 2, 'Storm schedule', settled 2026-11-27). Every number here is an INVENTED game-balance number. Only length, gap and warning scale with pace; the solar cut and the dust at storm end are physical and live in hazards/panel_dust.json (storm_output, storm_end) so pace can never touch them. Times are in sols of simulation time (a sol is 20 minutes of play). Phase 1 storm = the scheduled one; hold storm = the shorter drift-event storm (Phase 2 on, not scheduled yet; the operator command can start one).

storm_cap.note: Phase 1 storm cap (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.5). Later phases get their own caps when their storms are scheduled.
